body:
Full-codebase review, Android finding. Verified by reading.

`ApiException` extends `IOException` (Api.kt), and the close-vote paths in ListPropsViewModel and ExpenseListViewModel catch `IOException` first. Every server refusal — `409 list_closed`, `403 not_a_member`, `409 not_an_expenses_list` — is therefore shown as "couldn't reach the server, try again". AGENTS.md's rule is that server errors are shown by code.

Scenario: a collaborator's vote closes the list while the screen is open; the user taps agree-to-close and is told they are offline.

The same shadowing leaves an unreachable `catch (ApiException)` as dead code in OverviewViewModel. Fix direction: catch ApiException before IOException and route it through `ErrorText.of`; audit the other catch sites for the same order.
title: Android: server refusals are reported as being offline
